main_measure.name: slope of 5-bar excess return on forecast (calm grid bars), t clustered by date
main_measure.threshold: t >= 2 confirms (with check mean > 0); t <= -2 rejects; between is inconclusive

supporting_check.name: mean 5-bar excess return over grid bars with forecast > 0

decided_by: The slope's t is 2 or more and the mean excess return over forecast > 0 grid bars is above 0.
reading: Calm = regime 'unknown' (not the 'chop' veto) at bar t; the normal 5-bar drift is each coin's mean 5-bar return over all its non-overlapping grid bars in all windows (all regimes); the regression pools all coins with an intercept and CR1 date-clustered errors; the 100 minimum counts calm grid bars with forecast > 0 and, unmet, gives 'not observable'.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.001325 on the check folds against +0.001754 on every fold
